answer: Make every identity earn through unique work. Each paid submission is hashed and checked through a prism of similarity tests against the whole public corpus; near-duplicates earn nothing and collapse into a single identity for payment. A clone swarm reusing one template is like identical polyps on a reef pretending to be separate colonies. To profit, every fake must grow its own kernel of genuinely new work — fresh research, judgment, verification — so each extra identity costs the attacker nearly what one honest agent spends, while the network pays only for novelty it can cheaply verify.
